instructions:
## Task objective

Curate an instruction-tuning subset of the LESS 4-source mixture (flan_v2 / cot / dolly / oasst1, ~270K rows) so a LoRA-SFT Llama-2-7B performs as well as possible on MMLU and BBH. Budget is ~5% of the pool (the LESS selection ratio). This is the full text-domain task (real scores), in contrast to lessmix_llama2_mmlu_smoke. NOTE: TydiQA (the 3rd LESS benchmark) is implemented in the eval backend but omitted here — the vendored open-instruct version samples 1-shot from a GoldP *train* split GREATS did not ship and whose public GCS URL now 403s. Add "TydiQA" back once that split is provisioned (HF google-research-datasets/ tydiqa goldp + format conversion, or version-matched vendoring).

## Controlled curation loop

Inspect the supplied pool and implement a selection policy in the editable curation workspace. Produce the requested subset with the required schema, run the audit, and submit it through the benchmark CLI. The harness trains the fixed base model using the prescribed recipe and evaluates the checkpoint. Use the returned feedback to revise the selection policy. Do not alter the protected training or evaluation implementation.

## Exact published task configuration

```yaml
task:
  task_id: lessmix_llama2_2bench
  domain: text
  goal: >
    Curate an instruction-tuning subset of the LESS 4-source mixture (flan_v2 /
    cot / dolly / oasst1, ~270K rows) so a LoRA-SFT Llama-2-7B performs as well
    as possible on MMLU and BBH. Budget is ~5% of the pool (the LESS selection
    ratio). This is the full text-domain task (real scores), in contrast to
    lessmix_llama2_mmlu_smoke.
    NOTE: TydiQA (the 3rd LESS benchmark) is implemented in the eval backend but
    omitted here — the vendored open-instruct version samples 1-shot from a
    GoldP *train* split GREATS did not ship and whose public GCS URL now 403s.
    Add "TydiQA" back once that split is provisioned (HF google-research-datasets/
    tydiqa goldp + format conversion, or version-matched vendoring).
  target_rows: 13500
  training_stage: finetuning
  model_key: llama-2-7b
  model_name_or_path: __MODEL_PATH__
  target_evals:
    - MMLU
    - BBH
  strategy_timeout_seconds: null
  default_submission_dir: curated/final_submission
  training_config:
    # No max_steps: one full epoch over the curated subset (~844 steps at the
    # default effective batch of 16). num_train_epochs is fixed by the
    # curation-train TEXT_SFT defaults; raise it there for multi-epoch runs.
    num_processes: 1
    warmup_ratio: 0.03
    timeout_seconds: 14400
  eval_config:
    benchmarks:
      - MMLU
      - BBH
    offline: true
    mode: all
    timeout_seconds: 28800
    gpu_id: 0
    # No eval_options: full MMLU (57 subjects) + BBH (3-shot, 40/task) at the
    # open-instruct/LESS evaluation settings. (TydiQA omitted; see goal note.)
  dataset:
    dataset_id: lessmix
    local_path: __DATASET_PATH__
    split: null
```

Configuration source: [curation-bench/src/benchmark/tasks/lessmix_llama2_2bench.yaml](https://github.com/Jiachen-T-Wang/curation-bench-pro/blob/fb418bc9ce1c52416550ba6abf5968d8d594c760/curation-bench/src/benchmark/tasks/lessmix_llama2_2bench.yaml), [Apache-2.0 license](https://github.com/Jiachen-T-Wang/curation-bench-pro/blob/fb418bc9ce1c52416550ba6abf5968d8d594c760/LICENSE).
